title: General Assembly adopts pandemic declaration, but not by consensus
keyFacts: The General Assembly on Monday adopted a political declaration on pandemic prevention, preparedness and response, by 153 in favour to three against (Argentina, Israel and United States) with two abstentions (New Zealand and Paraguay).

title: Colombia peace deal must endure as insecurity grows, Security Council hears
